how_to_apply: Go to the official website at www.cusrinagar.edu.in to access the Online Recruitment Application Form.
Fill out the online application form and pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500/- online.
Submit the online application form by 21-10-2026 (04:30 PM).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The university has advertised a total of 01 vacancy for the Programmer position on a consolidated basis.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the essential qualification, experience, and residency requirements stipulated by Cluster University of Srinagar. Domicile: Applicants must be domiciles of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir. Essential Qualification: MCA/M.Sc. Computer Science / M.Sc. IT / B.Tech / B.E. (CS/IT) from a recognized University at least with 55% marks or equivalent Grades from a recognized University/Institute. Essential Experience: Minimum 05 years of experience in GOI projects/PSU/Industries or Pvt. Sector company of repute in ODL/ERP modules of a university, result processing, exam workflows and in Networking Cloud Services, OR Software Application development in .NET CORE and Deployment OR Database Management (Data Extraction, Transformation, Specialized Data Handling, Database backup and Recovery, Security/Authentication, Capacity Planning, Performance Monitoring and Tuning. Desirable Qualification: Preferably worked in open-source technology viz. C#, Java, MSSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, Agile Model Development Life Cycle, For networking and Cloud Management, Strong working and deployment knowledge in LINUX/Windows Servers. Server Management, Strong working experience in .NET technologies, including ASP.NET, C#, .NET, web API, Entity Framework Core.

content_sections.heading: CUS Programmer Application Fee
content_sections.text: Applicants are required to pay a non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500/- as per the specified timeline fixed by the university.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUS Programmer
content_sections.text: Go to the official website at www.cusrinagar.edu.in to access the Online Recruitment Application Form. Fill out the online application form and pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs. 500/- online. Submit the online application form by 21-10-2026 (04:30 PM). Take a printout of the submitted online application form. Enclose self-attested copies of testimonials and certificates with the printed application form in an envelope. Super-scribe the envelope clearly with "Application for the position of Programmer". Send or submit the hard copy of the application form so that it reaches the office of The Registrar, Cluster University of Srinagar Gogji bagh campus-190008 by or before 25-10-2026 (04:30 PM).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises three distinct evaluation stages: Written Test: Carries 50 marks in MCQ Format. Logic/Skill Test: Carries 30 marks, consisting of 02 tasks of 15 marks each to be solved by the candidate. Interview: Carries 20 marks and is mandatory to appear. The written test and Logic/Skill test (combined) shall form the basis for the shortlisting of candidates for the interview.
